# Downloaded UI assets

## Google Material Icons Round
Official Android VectorDrawable exports from https://github.com/google/material-design-icons
(Apache 2.0; see google-material-icons-LICENSE.txt). Downloaded 2026-11-13.
Home, bookmark_border, settings, restaurant, eco, local_fire_department, shuffle,
photo_camera, schedule, check, link, add, auto_awesome and remove replace the
previous hand-drawn in-app symbols. Their original path geometry is unchanged.
The app launcher logo is retained.

## Kenney Interface Sounds 1.0
Creator/source: https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds (CC0).
Downloaded from the pack mirror https://github.com/GeorgeQLe/assets-sfx-ui,
assets/kenney/interface-sounds/Audio/ on 2026-11-13.
- click_001.ogg → ui_click.ogg: home and screen button feedback
- confirmation_001.ogg → ui_confirm.ogg: completing a cooking step / sound preview
- confirmation_004.ogg → timer_complete.ogg: visible cooking timer completion

Files are unmodified. Original license: kenney-interface-sounds-LICENSE.txt.
Sounds can be disabled in Settings and respect silent/vibrate mode and system volume.
Timer sound is foreground feedback; it does not add a background alarm service.

The filled saved-state bookmark uses the official Google Material Icons Round `bookmark` Android vector (Apache 2.0), downloaded 2026-11-13. Its path geometry is unchanged.
